name: Damask
description: A foliate damask motif — a four-lobed figure set in a diamond, reversing with the weave.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 50.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 50.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 18%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); @shape: clover 4; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @even { -webkit-transform: rotate(45deg); transform: rotate(45deg); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
